objective: Turn the winery map into a Traverse City and Leelanau wine-country decision world without weakening the map-first search experience.

leelanauWineTrail.strength: Authoritative winery membership and trip-planning categories.
leelanauWineTrail.gapToExploit: Planning remains largely directory/category based rather than route plus outdoor pairing.

traverseCityTourism.strength: Strong destination storytelling, day trips, wineries, cideries and outdoor context.
traverseCityTourism.gapToExploit: Content is spread across destination pages rather than combined into one decision surface.

visitNapaValley.strength: Map-first winery discovery and itinerary inspiration.
visitNapaValley.gapToExploit: Wine discovery is strong, but nearby hikes, beaches, lighthouses and harbor-town pairing are not the core interaction.

mustFeelLike: a doorway into the broader Michigan outdoor tool network
